description: This file defines the 'ContactsViewDetail' class, a view class for displaying contact details in the SuiteCRM web application. It overrides the display method to manipulate portal-related display logic and includes external dependencies such as 'formLetter.php' and uses the BeanFactory for retrieving settings.

classes.name: ContactsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for displaying detailed contact information, extending the 'ViewDetail' base class, with custom display logic for portal features.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to conditionally show portal fields and include formLetter popup HTML, while retrieving admin settings.
